newsitem.title: USA: Citizens Mortgage to sell mortgaging unit.
newsitem.headline: Citizens Mortgage to sell mortgaging unit.

text.p: Citizens Mortgage Corp said Monday it plans to sell its $12 billion mortgage servicing portfolio, get out of the wholesale mortgage business and consolidate its Atlanta operations into New England.
The company said the move was aimed at repositioning itself to focus on retail mortgage lending and processing in New England.
It has retained Goldman Sachs & Co as an adviser to assit in the sale of the serving portfolio.
Citizens Mortgage said it was looking for a buyer who would continue providing servicing for mortgages it will originate through its banking franchise in New England.
It expects the sale to be completed within six months. The proceeds are to be invested in strengthening its New England-based mortgage originations and processing operations, it said.
Citizens Mortgage is a subsidiary of Citizens Financial Group Inc, which is a unit of the Royal Bank of Scotland.
Citizens Mortgage will merge into Citizens Bank of Rhode Island in 1997 once the sale of its servicing portfolio is completed.
